card_text: A slick back for Roswell: a work-ready cut for a town with few hard-hat jobs, planned around a long road.

seo.title: Slick Back Haircut for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Slick back haircuts for Roswell, cut in Carlsbad south on US 285. Why it fits an indoor workweek, how the sides set your schedule, and the booking.

paragraphs: Length on top combed straight back, sides taken short enough that the combed hair has an edge to sit against. A slick back is the cut I'd suggest to someone who has to look assembled by eight in the morning and wants to keep some hair doing it. I cut it in Carlsbad at {{address}}, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles south of Roswell on {{city:roswell.route}}, about {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes with Artesia at the midpoint (OpenStreetMap routing).
Below: why the cut suits the kind of work Roswell mostly does, how the sides set your calendar, and what to book.

blocks.heading: Few hard hats, more collars.
paragraphs: Just {{city:roswell.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} of Roswell's workers are in mining, oil, gas or agriculture, compared with {{city:carlsbad.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} here in Carlsbad (Census ACS 2023). A slick back doesn't survive a day under a hard hat; it does survive a day at a desk, a counter, a clinic or a classroom, because once it's combed back it mostly stays.

The median age in Roswell is {{city:roswell.median_age}} (Census ACS 2023). The slick back has long been a grown man's cut: the glossy, longer version on my styles page reads classic; the short one over a high skin fade reads modern. Pick the attitude, not the age.

blocks.heading: The top can wait for you. The sides can't.
paragraphs: Extra length on top actually helps a slick back lie down, so the top is patient. The fade or taper on the sides is what puffs out and dates the cut. With {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes between you and my chair, choose the sides with that in mind: a low taper softens slowly and buys you time; a high skin fade looks sharper and asks you back sooner.

blocks.heading: Two bookings, one direction.
blocks.lead: I style it before you stand up.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Sides at the height you choose, length shaped on top, straight razor at the neck, then combed back and finished.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Your slick back and your beard in one chair: trim or line-up, then a hot towel. A full beard under a slicked top is one of the looks on the styles page.

items.q: My hair is short now. Can I still book a slick back?
items.a: Book the cut, and I'll shape the sides and set the top up to grow into it. The length arrives on its own.

items.q: Taper or fade on the sides for someone who comes down rarely?
items.a: Taper. It grows out gently and keeps the cut looking tidy for longer between drives. The slick back page shows both sides done.

items.q: How do I keep it combed back once I'm home?
items.a: Ask me before you leave the chair; it depends on your hair.

blocks.heading:
Book the slick back.
Then point the car south.
